Hi Olga / team,

Thanks for the early heads-up and for including Marketplace Ops. A few quick compliance items from our side before publish: 

1) AMI naming: Marketplace requires the version token to be clearly parseable (we prefer semantics: <product>-<major>.<minor>.<patch>-<build>). Your current runtime tag is acceptable but please add the explicit semantic version as a suffix (e.g., redwood-inference-runtime-3.2.1-20271020).

2) Footnote language: your proposed "minimal ephemeral caching; long-term storage only with explicit customer opt-in" is acceptable. Please also include a line that references the AWS Marketplace terms where customers can read the retention policy: link to marketplace user guide is fine. 

3) KMS: If you intend to use a partner-managed key alias for snapshot encryption you must register the alias in the partner profile. If you keep the existing alias, we recommend documenting key rotation cadence in the listing attachments.

We can accept the hero as-is (preferred version) but please confirm the final text in your marketplace submission form and attach the updated legal footnote file. Once you upload the 3 artifacts (hero text, legal-footnote-draft.md updated, and AMI matrix) to the partner portal we'll queue the listing for a marketplace-ops review (target 48 hours).

Sarah Lindstrom
AWS Partner Manager
Amazon Web Services
